US-FEDERAL.tax_scope: US federal income tax; not state sales tax

rules.phaseout_rule: The maximum deduction is reduced, but not below zero, by the amount that the cost of Section 179 property placed in service during the tax year exceeds the phaseout threshold.

qualification_summary: Qualified property under IRC section 168(k), including eligible MACRS tangible property with a recovery period of 20 years or less and other specifically listed property.
ADS property and other statutory exclusions may disqualify an asset.
rules.note: The 40%/60% election is limited to the first tax year ending after 2025-01-19; it is not a general 2026 default rate.

source.title: Publication 946 (2025), How To Depreciate Property
source_sections: Chapter 3: Certain Qualified Property Acquired and Placed in Service After January 19, 2025

JP-INDIVIDUAL-INCOME-TAX.tax_scope: Japan individual income tax; qualifying blue-return taxpayers only, subject to statutory conditions

rules.cost_tax_inclusion_rule: The acquisition-cost test uses tax-inclusive cost for tax-inclusive bookkeeping and tax-exclusive cost for tax-exclusive bookkeeping; exempt taxpayers use tax-inclusive bookkeeping.
rules.lending_asset_exclusion: Assets acquired on or after 2022-04-01 and used for lending are excluded unless lending is the principal business.

source.title: No.2100 減価償却のあらまし
